scriptVerdict: Book-first purpose, selection/race diagnosis and proposed institutional alternative are coherent. No narration change requested. The furniture example is explicitly supported as a narrow promise in chapter 10; workshops, people and joint are acceptable conceptual elaboration, not a reported pilot or guaranteed economic result.

verifiedPlanQuotes.quote: A brand is not a logo. A brand is compressed trust.
Their distinctive unit is the shared name governed as a commons.
The right to fork is decisive.
People cooperate when the commons makes them more capable.
The promise must be narrow enough to audit and broad enough to let branches adapt.
repairable furniture designed globally and made locally

materialFindings.problem: Contribution memory is named but not demonstrated: the page has no creator identifier, its generic Contributor record label remains at the writer’s desk, and the repairer never receives or consults the instruction. Sliding a spare onto a finished chair does not communicate reuse with retained credit.
materialFindings.fix: Give the guide an explicitly illustrative creator identity or stable contributor mark, retain it when the guide is copied/moved to the receiving bench, and make the second operator consult its joint instruction before fitting a missing part. The original may remain available; no payment or outcome number needed.

evidence.quote: Begin with a ledger of useful work: documents written, tools built, customers served, audits performed, training delivered, bugs fixed, disputes mediated, local partnerships created, research validated, and standards improved.

materialFindings.problem: Teaching remains a caption and generic gesture. Both people stay well away from an already-complete chair; the extra joint moves automatically about thirty pixels, while the learner never performs a changed operation. Thus the concrete skill transfer promised by the art plan is not visible.
materialFindings.fix: Use a close joint assembly with a genuine missing component; mentor demonstrates once, then learner approaches and repeats the fit with a matching second part or reset assembly. Hold the finished learner result beside the shared instruction, without claiming measured competence.

evidence.quote: Each transition should have evidence, standards, mentoring, and appeal.

materialFindings.problem: Shared-name/exit is reduced to replacing a central label. Both chairs remain visually and institutionally identical, the operator register has no identifiable entries, and no actual prior history accompanies a departing operator. Viewers cannot see what exits, what changes, or what survives the fork.
materialFindings.fix: Identify two illustrative operators under the common promise; let one move to a visibly distinct branch name while retaining the same credited guide/history from scene 4. Keep original institution visible and show traceable origin, with no badge implying real certification.

evidence.quote: In a decentralised brand, a fork should allow a legitimate subgroup to exit with a traceable relation to the original, preserving contribution history and making the dispute intelligible to customers.

broaderPattern: The repeated completed-chair-on-bench composition limits differentiation. The three targeted mechanisms above can also provide the needed scale and action variation; a whole new metaphor or narration rewrite is unnecessary.
renderingLimit: All-theme collision and caption checks remain root’s responsibility; passing those does not resolve these semantic art findings.
